City Manager gave a report.

ACM Roberts introduced Dr. Babae (check spelling).

Dr. Babae gave an update on the COVID-19 testing; use of two labs; delay of shipments; discussed new system; may get duplicate results; suggest register before going to test; insurance information

Mayor inquired if Dr. has done this type of large scale testing.

Dr. Babae stated no and discussed the process and did not expect the large amount of people.

Mayor thanked US Health Fairs for their service.

Mayor Pro Tem Dear noted did not receive results since May 19.

Dr. Babae will be large amount of email to send and not certain who did not receive results which are thousands; recreated the system

Mayor Pro Tem Dear noted he initiated the idea with support of his colleagues; inquired if can get another test.

Dr. Babae should receive results within two weeks.

MPT do they have to reregister.

Dr. Babae starting next week will have unique login and will not have to re-register.

MPT inquired if still need to show SS number.

Dr. Babae - social security card is an identifier; each person has to register separately.

LDH - concern that staff receiving negative feedback and should be informed what is taking place; residents are upset.

Dr. Babae discussed retesting and maybe receiving multiple emails.

LDH - noted MLK (county site) also provides testing with results within three days.

Hicks - can you streamline those who have not received tests.

Hilton - test any good

Dr. Babae - revamped and ideally turnaround in for days.

Mayor requested end of week doctor to provide data, number tested, number positive, demographics

Michael Whittiker, Human Services Manager, gave a PowerPoint presentation update of the COVID-19 Task Force work.
